sentences.en: Humidity doesn't seem to matter much to the COVID virus.
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒似乎不太在意湿度。

sentences.en: Please avoid storing in areas with high temperature and humidity.
sentences.zh: 请避免存放在高温高湿的地方。

sentences.en: What with the heat and the humidity, I didn't sleep well.
sentences.zh: 因为炎热和潮湿，我睡得不好。

senses.zh: （空气中的）湿度,潮湿，高温潮湿,湿热,物湿度
